name: Frontend Development
description: Minimal toolchain for modern frontend development with React, Next.js, or similar frameworks. Includes containerisation for running backend services locally.

notes.git: Version control and the foundation for CI/CD pipelines and Vercel/Netlify deployments.
notes.node: JavaScript runtime. Required to run the dev server, bundler (Vite/Webpack), and all npm tooling.
notes.docker: Run backend services (databases, APIs) locally via docker-compose without installing them natively.
